class.name: ArtNetController
class.brief_description: Controller for sending ArtNet DMX data over IP networks.
class.description:
ArtNetController provides a GDScript interface to the libartnet library, allowing you to send DMX lighting control data over ArtNet protocol. This enables control of DMX fixtures from Godot projects.
ArtNet is a protocol that allows transmission of DMX-512 data over IP networks, commonly used in professional lighting control systems.
[b]Note:[/b] ArtNet networking is not supported on WebAssembly/WASM platforms. Methods will return errors on WASM builds.
Two ways to use it: - A classic node: [method configure] (one output port), [method start], then [method set_dmx_data] + [method send_dmx] to transmit, or [method read] + [method get_dmx_data] to receive that one universe. - Frame streaming for pixel installations with hundreds of universes: [method configure_receive] + [method start] + [method read] + [method take_frame] on the receiving side, and [method send_frame] on the sending side (no node, no port binding). Frames are delimited by the ArtDmx sequence byte, which every universe of one frame shares.
libartnet binds UDP port 6454 on every interface with SO_REUSEPORT and needs a non-loopback network interface to exist. By default it also drops packets sent from this host; see [method set_accept_local_packets].
[codeblock] # Configure and start ArtNet controller var artnet = ArtNetController.new() if artnet.configure("192.168.1.100", 6454, 0, 0, 0): if artnet.start(): print("ArtNet controller started")
# Set DMX data (512 channels) var dmx_data = PackedByteArray() dmx_data.resize(512) dmx_data[0] = 255 # Channel 1 at full brightness dmx_data[1] = 128 # Channel 2 at half brightness
if artnet.set_dmx_data(0, dmx_data): if artnet.send_dmx(): print("DMX data sent")
# Clean up artnet.stop() [/codeblock]

method.name: configure
method.description:
Configures the ArtNet node with network settings. This must be called before [method start].
- [code]bind_address[/code]: IP address to bind the ArtNet node to (e.g., "192.168.1.100") - [code]port[/code]: UDP port number (typically 6454 for ArtNet) - [code]net[/code]: ArtNet net address (0-127) - [code]subnet[/code]: ArtNet subnet address (0-15) - [code]universe[/code]: DMX universe number (0-15 within the subnet) - [code]broadcast_address[/code]: Broadcast address for sending ArtNet packets (default: "255.255.255.255")
Returns [code]true[/code] on success, [code]false[/code] on error.

method.name: start
method.description:
Starts the ArtNet node and begins network operations. Must be called after [method configure] and before [method send_dmx].
Returns [code]true[/code] on success, [code]false[/code] on error.

method.name: stop
method.description: Stops the ArtNet node and stops all network operations. Call this when you're done using the controller.

method.name: is_running
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the ArtNet node is currently running, [code]false[/code] otherwise.

method.name: set_dmx_data
method.description:
Sets the DMX channel data to be sent. The data array can contain up to 512 bytes (one byte per DMX channel).
- [code]universe[/code]: The DMX universe to send data to - [code]data[/code]: PackedByteArray containing DMX channel values (0-255 per channel)
Returns [code]true[/code] on success, [code]false[/code] if data exceeds 512 channels.

method.name: send_dmx
method.description:
Sends the DMX data that was set with [method set_dmx_data] over the ArtNet network.
Must be called after [method start] and [method set_dmx_data].
Returns [code]true[/code] on success, [code]false[/code] on error.

method.name: configure_receive
method.description:
Creates a node that receives [param universe_count] consecutive universes starting at the 15-bit port address [param start_universe] (Net in the high byte, Sub-Net and Universe in the low byte), each contributing [param channels_per_universe] bytes to one contiguous frame. Call [method start] afterwards and [method read] every frame. An empty [param bind_address] picks the first network interface.
Every ArtDmx packet is routed by our own handler, so the 4-port limit of a classic node does not apply. A frame is published when a packet carries a new sequence byte, when a universe repeats, or when the last universe arrives; universes missing from a frame keep the previous frame's bytes. Unknown Art-Net opcodes are swallowed silently.

method.name: set_accept_local_packets
method.description: libartnet drops packets whose source is this host's own IP address or 127.0.0.1, so two programs on one machine never hear each other. Pass [code]true[/code] to accept them (a renderer and a visualizer on the same computer). Default [code]false[/code].

method.name: get_accept_local_packets
method.description: Whether packets from this host are accepted. See [method set_accept_local_packets].

method.name: set_receive_buffer_size
method.description: Asks the kernel for a larger UDP receive buffer (SO_RCVBUF) so a burst of several hundred universes survives a slow frame. Halves the request until the kernel accepts it. Applied immediately when running, otherwise on [method start].

method.name: has_frame
method.description: [code]true[/code] when a complete (or flushed) frame is waiting for [method take_frame].

method.name: take_frame
method.description: The latest published frame as one contiguous stream of [code]universe_count * channels_per_universe[/code] bytes (universe 0 first), or an empty array when none is waiting. Clears [method has_frame].

method.name: get_frame_sequence
method.description: The ArtDmx sequence byte of the last published frame.

method.name: flush_frame
method.description: Publishes the universes received so far as a frame, for a trailing partial frame that no later packet will complete. Returns [code]false[/code] when nothing is pending.

method.name: get_receive_stats
method.description: Counters: [code]packets[/code], [code]frames[/code], [code]partial_frames[/code], [code]ignored[/code] (universes outside the configured range), [code]pending[/code] (universes of the frame being assembled), [code]last_sequence[/code], [code]universe_count[/code], [code]channels_per_universe[/code].

method.name: send_frame
method.description: Sends [param data] as consecutive ArtDmx universes of [param channels_per_universe] bytes, starting at the 15-bit port address [param start_universe], unicast (or broadcast for a x.x.x.255 address) to [param dest_address]:[param dest_port]. The last universe may be short; odd lengths are padded with one zero byte. All universes of one call share a sequence byte (1..255, advancing per call). Uses a plain UDP socket of its own, so it needs no [method configure] or [method start] and never binds the Art-Net port. Returns the number of universes sent, or -1 on a bad argument.
